text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills rose to 47.86 percent from 47.56 percent at the last sale on January 10, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 32.68 million UAH 8.85 million UAH
Actual amount raised 29.19 million UAH 7.91 million UAH
The central bank sold 326,791 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 178,485 were competitive and 148,306 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 58.86 percent from 59.06 percent at the last sale on January 10, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 120.01 million UAH 81.72 million UAH
Actual amount raised 92.78 million UAH 63.13 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,200,183 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 855,847 were competitive and 344,336 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 60.69 percent from 61.11 percent at the last sale on January 10, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 43.78 million UAH 5.63 million UAH
Actual amount raised 30.11 million UAH 3.86 million UAH
The central bank sold 437,870 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 388,101 were competitive and 49,769 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills slipped to 60.78 against 61.20 percent at the last sale on January 4, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 4,509 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 2,940 was competitive and 1,569 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 15.
